description: Thinking & Casing Refactor - Centralize case conversion and thinking logic, remove forced thinking, and enforce snake_case serialization only at provider boundaries.

userStories.title: Rollback forced thinking logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the forced thinking budget/includeThoughts logic so that user intent is respected.
acceptanceCriteria: Retain only disable logic for `isThinkingEnabled === false || isClaudeFresh`
userStories.notes: Changed isThinkingEnabled !== true to isThinkingEnabled === false to respect user intent

userStories.title: Create casing utilities
userStories.description: As a developer, I want reusable case conversion utilities so that I don't duplicate conversion logic across providers.

userStories.title: Create deep key conversion utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a deep key conversion utility so that I can transform entire request objects at provider boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `convertKeysDeep<T>(value: T, converter: KeyConverter, options?): T`
Test preservation of null, undefined, primitive values
Test `preserveKeys` option to exclude specific keys
userStories.notes: Implemented convertKeysDeep with full test coverage

userStories.title: Define ThinkingPolicy type
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single ThinkingPolicy type so that thinking decisions are centralized and explicit.
acceptanceCriteria: Define `ThinkingPolicy` type (enabled, mode, includeThoughtsInResponse, sendThinkingToUpstream, reason)
userStories.notes: Created ThinkingPolicy type with enabled, mode, includeThoughtsInResponse, sendThinkingToUpstream, reason fields. Added factory functions for convenience.

userStories.title: Implement isThinkingModel helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want model capability detection to be table-driven so that string matching heuristics are not scattered.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace existing `includes('thinking')` calls with new helper
userStories.notes: Created table-driven model-capabilities.ts with 28 tests. Updated transform-utils.ts and request.ts to use centralized helper.

userStories.title: Implement computeThinkingPolicy function
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a function that computes thinking policy from inputs so that I don't scatter thinking logic across layers.
acceptanceCriteria: Inputs: model, mode, clientThinking, optionsThinking, isClaudeFresh, sourceFormat, targetProvider
Test thinking model + streaming -> interleaved mode
Test explicit client thinking config priority
userStories.notes: Implemented computeThinkingPolicy with 20 tests covering all scenarios

userStories.title: Update PrepareUpstreamOptions to use ThinkingPolicy
userStories.description: As a developer, I want upstream options to use ThinkingPolicy so that providers receive structured decisions.

userStories.title: Use ThinkingPolicy in transform-pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the transform pipeline to use ThinkingPolicy so that thinking overrides are policy-driven.

userStories.title: Serialize snake_case in Antigravity provider
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Antigravity provider to serialize to snake_case at the boundary so that conversion is not scattered.
acceptanceCriteria: Use `convertKeysDeep()` in Antigravity transform for final serialization
Ensure `thinking_config`, `include_thoughts`, `thinking_budget` exist only in wire format
Verify request format matches opencode-antigravity-auth library

userStories.title: Update anthropic-beta header logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I want anthropic-beta header logic to use ThinkingPolicy so that header decisions are centralized.
acceptanceCriteria: Ensure header logic is only in upstream strategy

userStories.title: Maintain thoughtSignature compatibility
userStories.description: As a developer, I want streaming parser to handle both camelCase and snake_case thoughtSignature so that responses are correctly parsed.

userStories.title: E2E Test - Antigravity thinking requests
userStories.description: As a developer, I want E2E tests verifying Antigravity thinking requests so that the refactor doesn't break production.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test: thinking model + streaming -> correct headers/body
E2E test: non-thinking model -> no thinking config
E2E test: Claude Fresh -> thinking disabled

userStories.title: E2E Test - Format Compatibility
userStories.description: As a developer, I want E2E tests verifying format compatibility so that existing clients continue to work.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test: OpenAI format -> Antigravity conversion
E2E test: Anthropic format -> Antigravity conversion
E2E test: Gemini CLI format conversion
Verify compatibility with patterns from ai, litellm, opencode
